name: Min-arc stop knuckle 4R: a preloaded one-sided knuckle in link 1 with J2 hard stops (plain spherical chain)

mechanism.notes: spherical 3R with link 1 split by a passive knuckle K. bodies: link 1a, link 1b, link 2, member 3 (hub-3 arm-end plate + K7 neck). joints: J1, K, J2, J3 O20 hubs on MR117-2RS pairs (revolutes). Open chain, GH closes it: loop mobility 4 vs the arm's 3 - the spare is set by the clock spring in K's cap (preload onto stop A) and the J2 interior-angle hard stops (min-arc law), so nothing sags (R17). sensed: K (encoder, the 4th coordinate is not a function of J1-J3 readings alone). custom: base, 3 links, member 3, 4 hub shafts, the clock spring strip (0.2 x 3 mm stainless, ~4 turns); catalogue: 4 x MR117-2RS pair + 2 O2 ISO 8734 stop dowels (K stop arc slot, J2 stop arc slot).

v_verdict: REFUTED (both lenses; a third, skeptic lens agrees). The claimed 15.42 reproduces to the digit, but only in the model's J2 interior-angle fold reading: its J2 stops (phi 12.28 / 162.70) let the J1-J3 dyad come within 1.88 / 1.37 deg of its fold (kit metric, the one H1 and every verified row use; 5 deg = phi 20.8 / 146.6), below the user's 5-deg lower bound, with J2 hitting the stretched stop at a rate ratio of 6.35 (H1's worst 3.15). Kept stops under the kit rule: 21.33 static, 35.56 connected. Priced (stops moved to the 5-deg margin): 18.45 frozen exact, connected, near-touch 24.26 (score 93.29), held out 22.27 vs H1 31.39 under the same harness - better than the verified H1 (27.20 same protocol, 24.48 polish) by 6-9 points, but it is a different configuration than the one claimed and is not confirmed here. Mechanism (lens 2): the J2 'hard stop' acts on a virtual angle no dowel at J2 can stop (physical q2 stop law: no cost, gains 1.13), and the specified 0.2 x 3 mm clock spring cannot carry 0.08-0.113 N.m (a 0.3 x 5 mm strip in a 6 mm taller cap: no cost). Next: re-claim with the q2-stop model fix and a near-touch CMA holding the stops >= 5 deg from the J1-J3 fold, then a fresh two-lens verification.
